Title: Azure App Service new full screen experience is now available

Body.Content:
Azure App Service is offering a new, full screen experience that simplifies the application creation and publishing workflow. The new experience guides you through important decisions such as selecting OS, application stack, or publishing mode, and also enables more comprehensive validation of user choices.

Learn more
